NOT_PREDICTED_FOUND_BY_EYE.mechanism: that rim sky was fed by the aug14/set-04 members' entry-side TOP-RIGHT corners (GO #8: rho 0.81-0.90, member x ~ W-300 = centre+2600 — beyond centre+900, so CROPPED) plus july31/set-03's; the crop removes exactly the contributions that gave the canonical its smooth rim, and what remains is the july31 members' frame-edge strips, each with its own level (the sky x V edge residual) and noise. The hard crop starves the rim's contributor diversity the same way exclusion did — the crop5lr root cause (docs/dead-ends/stacking-compose.md, the retired --crop-lr rule: 'the crop damages no member but changes WHO reaches the rim') at the union's left rim under the RA flip
NOT_PREDICTED_FOUND_BY_EYE.where_it_sits: at the canvas RIM, not at the crop boundaries (those are in the deep interior and pass); the band's shape gain and the rim's coverage loss are the same columns seen from two places
NOT_PREDICTED_FOUND_BY_EYE.by_the_fold: the director's fold to the pre-registration made 'a visible edge at 1:1' a FAIL for the hard-crop form regardless of the band's shape gain — the rim carries visible edges at 1:1; the boundary test itself passes; the ruling is the director's
NOT_PREDICTED_FOUND_BY_EYE.what_it_points_at: a form that keeps the cropped columns' COVERAGE where they are the only cover (tapered weight toward the entry edge — the SWarp weight-map form — or a position-dependent crop that spares the rim contributions), instead of removing them outright
